items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions Johnny Dankworth in the context of Cleo Laine's album; Interviewee does not mention any personal or professional connection to Johnny Dankworth.

ctx.x: And there's an album that Cleo Laine recorded in England with Johnny Dankworth, which is rather different in conception from yours. And is the album in question that we're going to go on and talk about which is entitled, 'Sullivan, Shakespeare, Hyman,' on the Monmouth-Evergreen label, recorded in June of 1971 These are settings of works of Shakespeare
